jobs.description_text: Team Overview Deepgram’s Frontier Research Staff works at the frontier of audio AI, across both perception and generation, from speech-to-text to text-to-speech. We start from open-ended questions about what models can do and how they should be built, then pursue new approaches through experiments that become the research foundations for our STT and TTS systems. We measure success by whether the work advances what our models can do. Real-time is the constraint that shapes every question we ask. Latent Space Models is our bet on a new paradigm for audio AI. The goal is for voice to become the natural interface to technology. The team works closely with engineering, infrastructure, product, data, and marketing to carry breakthroughs from first experiment into production. jobs.title: Loan Processor: Small Business Funding
jobs.description_text: LOAN PROCESSOR, SMALL BUSINESS FUNDING Rail Capital Full time. Utah based (Salt Lake City, Provo, or anywhere along the Wasatch Front). Reports to the Managing Director. ABOUT RAIL CAPITAL Rail Capital provides working capital to small businesses through merchant cash advances. Our underwriting is fast, data driven, and grounded in bank statement cash flow rather than collateral. We are building a modern credit operation with automation at the center, and we need a processor who has moved high volumes of small business files from application to funding and wants to help design how it is done here. THE ROLE You will own every file from submission to funded. You will collect and verify documents, clear conditions, prepare contracts, run the final checks, and release funds. The underwriter decides the credit. You make sure the file is complete, true, and funded the same day whenever possible. This is a hands on seat. You will work files every day and you will be measured on speed to fund, accuracy, and how few files come back with a problem. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Intake new submissions from brokers and direct merchants: check the application, bank statements, and identification for completeness and chase what is missing. - Package files for underwriting so the underwriter never waits on a document. - Clear conditions to fund: voided check, proof of ownership, driver license, landlord or mortgage verification, tax returns, payoff letters, and any stipulation the underwriter sets. -

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description_text: The Position: As a Principal Software Engineer, you will shape the technical vision and lead the delivery of integrations and APIs built and operated as products. Your initial focus will be the Partner API: turning GameChanger’s capabilities and domain expertise into secure, reliable, scalable, and intuitive experiences that external developers and partners can build on with confidence. Over time, your impact will extend across product lines and the broader engineering organization as you help establish durable technical direction and raise the standard for backend and API engineering. This is a hands-on technical leadership role, not a hands-off architecture position. You will work directly with engineers to design, build, launch, and operate integrations and APIs, making consequential architectural decisions and contributing to critical implementation work.
